observe-run.description: Observe the change a CI job built, in a repository that keeps its own CI and needs no Putnami workspace. It detects GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or a generic CI, names the repository by its code host and numeric project id, resolves the commit the change is measured against, deepening a shallow clone up to the merge base, lists the changed files, and finds the test and coverage reports the job produced. A missing or malformed report, or a base it cannot reach, is a diagnostic: only a usage error exits non-zero (2). It prints a text summary, or one JSON document with --output=json. In the caller's directory it writes only the Git history it fetches, which --no-fetch turns off.

base.description: Commit or branch the change is measured against; overrides what the CI says. Required for a generic CI.

head.description: Commit that was built; default HEAD.

junit.description: Comma-separated JUnit XML report paths or glob patterns; replaces JUnit discovery.

coverage.description: Comma-separated coverage report paths or glob patterns (LCOV, Cobertura, Clover, Go cover profile); replaces coverage discovery.

fetch.description: Fetch the base and deepen a shallow clone up to the merge base; --no-fetch reads only the local history.

observe.description: Observe a change in a repository that keeps its own CI.

run.description: Detect the CI, the diff base, the changed files and the reports of this job.

examples.description: In a GitHub Actions or GitLab CI job, after the tests.
In another CI, measured against main.
Name the reports and print one JSON document.
